name: loose
vision: The hips lead and everything that hangs follows late and swings past: a deep contrapposto, long overlap on the arms and the head.

idle: For a loose, lived-in character: the weight goes 80 % onto a leg and the hips tip 13 degrees.
Could not be done: the deepest shift still reads 1.3 mm of hand in thigh on the female (the limit is 5); the free foot stays flat, a heel that lifts was not tried.
crouch_idle: Shipped as gds/Crouch_Idle (the maintainer's choice, 2026-11-12). A deep, wide kneel: the right foot 0.65 m behind and 0.10 m wider, turned out 35 degrees with its heel up 54; the hips turned 18 degrees and the shoulders 17 the other way, the head looking over the left knee; the right hand is held over the low right thigh and the left forearm on the left thigh.

Could not be done: the left arm hanging free outside the high knee or between the knees: its forearm went 20 to 55 mm into the thigh; and the weight shifting as far as the first loose crouch did (0.14 of the share): the rear knee bent 150 degrees (the limit is 140), so the shift is 0.04. The right hand lying on the knee: the pistol it holds sat 32 mm inside the form female's thigh, so the hand is held 0.06 m higher and the pistol is 11 mm clear of her and 26 mm of the form male. The left elbow bends 74 degrees (58 in A): at 58 the forearm lay 15 mm inside the form female's knee.

Fixed on the form bodies: the left arm is carried 25 degrees out. At 18 the left hand went 10 to 30 mm into the form female's calf as the knee came up to it at the end of the stride; it reads 0 mm on the four bodies now.

The audit's planted rows count the frame before each landing as planted (the sole 6 mm up, inside its band of a fifth of the lift) and read 37.9 mm of wander; in the declared contacts the sole wanders 2.2 mm on the form female.

Tried: the loose hand overlap (3 frames, 0.35 past): the left hand trailed 21 mm into the thigh that rose under it; the forearm and the hand trail 1.5 frames here.

Tried: the foot landing at frame 18: the head and the left forearm kicked 0.8 and 1.1 degrees on the landing frame as the ends were let go; it lands at 16 and the ends are let go over 4 frames.
walk: Loose: a longer step (129 steps a minute), the hips turn 12 degrees and tip 9, the pelvis sways 64 mm, the left arm goes through 65 degrees and the forearm and the hand trail two frames and swing past. Each side has its own numbers and its own timing: the right arm is held tighter with its shoulder lower and comes forward later, the right foot turns out more and its heel comes up later.

Tried and held back: an overshoot of 0.25 to 0.3 on the forearm and the hand. At a gait's pace the spring rings: the elbow went 21 degrees past straight and the hand 100 degrees from the forearm; it is 0.15 and 0.2. The hands keep 22 cm from the thigh's line to clear the hips.
jog: Loose: the hips turn 16 degrees and the shoulders 25, the pelvis sways 52 mm, the hands are half open and the left arm goes through 108 degrees, trailing a frame and a half. Each side has its own numbers and its own timing: the right arm is held tighter with its shoulder lower and comes forward later, the right foot turns out more and its heel comes up later.
Could not be done: the hands as near the hips as the grounded one's (62 mm inside the pelvis on the male with the wider swing); the elbows go 18 degrees out as they pass back.

Its lean is the closest to the acceleration's (5.9 degrees over a step, declared 9): three more frames of gathering are three more frames of falling.
